panels.heading: Starting from zero
panels.body: El Puma Contigo, Machine Stock, a handful of personal apps — built from a blank screen, with the architecture and an AI-assisted workflow decided from day one, working directly with whoever's paying for it to keep the roadmap honest.

panels.heading: Starting from someone else's mess
panels.body: Techint's internal app, PassApp, Be Soul — codebases with years of decisions already baked in, sometimes no tests at all. Same method: understand what's there before touching it, build the safety net, then change what needs changing.

closingNote: Either way, I document as I go and build the kind of test coverage that makes AI-assisted changes safe instead of risky — which is also how I ended up leading the first AI agent shipped inside a real product, not the kind you just use to write one.
